channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Texas Democrat Faces Voter Questions on Key Issues
item.description: Texas Democratic Senate nominee James Talarico faced scrutiny from undecided voters at a town hall event, addressing contentious issues including abortion, faith, and "conspiracy theories." Talarico presented himself as a moderate aiming… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: NY Governor and Challenger Clash in Debate
item.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul and her challenger, Lee Zeldin, engaged in a heated debate covering topics including former President Trump, political figure Mohsin Mamdani, and the cost of living. During the exchange, Hochul deflected… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Federal Reserve's Lisa Cook faces 'biased' White House hearing, lawyers claim
item.description: Lawyers for Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook have stated that a White House hearing concerning her is biased. They expressed doubts about the fairness of the process, with President Trump reportedly calling her an 'automatic no vote'… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Political Candidates Debate Ahead of Midterm Elections
item.description: In the United States, political candidates are engaging in debates as midterm elections approach. In Georgia, Jon Ossoff and Herschel Walker participated in a debate. Separately, in Illinois, Governor J.B. Pritzker and challenger Darren… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: California Billionaire Tax Debated Amid Millionaire's Departure
item.description: California's proposed tax on billionaires is facing scrutiny, with one 23-year-old millionaire stating the tax contributed to his decision to avoid the state. The debate centers on the potential impact of wealth taxes on attracting and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Pakistan Suspends Imran Khan's Provincial Government
item.description: Pakistan has suspended the provincial government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, which was led by the party of jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan. This action compounds the difficulties faced by Khan, who is currently incarcerated. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Rubio Warns State Dept. Staff on Ethics After Guilfoyle Ouster
item.description: U.S. Senator Marco Rubio has issued an ethics warning to State Department staff following the dismissal of Kimberly Guilfoyle. The warning reminds diplomats to avoid conflicts of interest. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Japan Agriculture Minister Resigns Over Funding Scandal
item.description: Japan's Agriculture Minister Tetsuro Nomura has resigned from his post following allegations of a funding scandal. He is the first minister to step down from the cabinet led by Prime Minister Fumio Kishida. Reports indicate that the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ohio Working-Class Voters Rethink Support for Trump, Republicans
item.description: Working-class voters in Ohio are reportedly reconsidering their support for Donald Trump and the Republican Party. This shift in sentiment in Ohio could influence upcoming elections, potentially impacting control of the U.S. Congress… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: FBI denies director's Russia trip, confirms Virginia presence
item.description: The FBI has denied reports that its director, Kash Patel, traveled to Russia. The agency confirmed that Patel was in Virginia at the time the reports surfaced. The reports, which circulated amid accusations against Ukraine for allegedly… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Trump says government leakers "should be shot"
item.description: During a campaign rally in Arizona, former U.S. President Donald Trump stated that government officials who leak information to the media "should be shot." Trump's remarks, made during a rally intended to support candidates in the midterm… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Former VP Dhankhar to attend RSS event; Congress criticizes government-Sangh 'ecosystem'
item.description: Former Vice President Jagdeep Dhankhar has been invited as a special guest to the RSS Vijaya Dashami ceremony. Following this invitation, the Congress party criticized the central government and the RSS, referring to them as an… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Samajwadi Party Chief Demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar's Removal
item.description: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav has demanded the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The demand comes amid discussions about the CEC's position, with one report suggesting impeachment or legal action if guilt is… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: US Proposal May Increase Scrutiny for Indian H-1B Visa Holders
item.description: A proposed change by the U.S. government could subject Indian workers on H-1B visas to renewed scrutiny, even if they have received prior approvals. The H-1B visa is typically granted for an initial period of three years, with the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India Rejects China's Objection to Naming Ladakh Locations
item.description: China has opposed India's decision to name 28 strategic locations in Ladakh. India has rejected China's objection to this move. The specific locations and the nature of the strategic importance were not detailed in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Congress Reaches Out to CJP Amid Internal Disagreement
item.description: The Congress party is reportedly changing its stance regarding the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP). Rahul Gandhi has extended an offer for 'high tea' to Abhijeet Dipke, indicating a potential shift in the party's approach towards CJP… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India seeks UN report on Pakistan's actions in PoK
item.description: India has requested the UN Human Rights Council to investigate and report on Pakistan's actions and human rights situation in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK). India also urged the UN Human Rights Bodies to end politicization and rejected… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Odisha Governor's 'Work for BJP' Remark Sparks Row
item.description: Odisha Governor Raghubar Das's statement that he would "work to strengthen the BJP" has triggered a political controversy. The Biju Janata Dal (BJD) expressed shock and condemned the remark. The Congress party has demanded the Governor's… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Three Samajwadi Party MLAs Join BJP in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh
item.description: Three Samajwadi Party (SP) MLAs, Rakesh Pratap Singh, Abhay Singh, and Vinod Chaturvedi, have formally joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh. The MLAs had been out of the SP for over a year and had cross-voted in… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Netanyahu, Trump Discussed Potential Iran Strikes, Reports Say
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, referred to as 'Bibi', reportedly discussed potential further strikes on Iran with former US President Donald Trump. An unnamed US official cited by Hindustan Times stated that Netanyahu expressed… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Mandates Aadhaar for Electricity Subsidy
item.description: The Delhi government has made Aadhaar mandatory for residents to receive electricity subsidies. An Aadhaar enrolment ID will be accepted as an alternative for those who do not yet have the card. This decision comes as the annual outlay for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: PM Modi to inaugurate 5 Ladakh projects worth ₹3,350 crore
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate five major infrastructure and development projects in Ladakh on Thursday. The projects are collectively valued at ₹3,350 crore and span areas from airports and parks to roads. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Government announces pension for persons with 40% disability from birth
item.description: The Union Cabinet has approved a decision to provide pensions to individuals with 40% disability from birth. This decision was announced by Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. The names of several schemes have also been changed as part of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: UK Leader Seeks to Mend Ukraine-US Ties Ahead of Zelensky Visit
item.description: Ahead of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's meeting with UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak, UK leader Andy Burnham stated his desire to 'repair bridges' between Ukraine and the United States. Burnham conveyed this message to Ukraine. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: J&K Waqf Board Reverses Decision on Uniform Friday Sermons Amid Opposition
item.description: The Jammu and Kashmir Waqf Board has taken a U-turn on its proposal to pre-decide topics for Friday sermons. Chairperson Darakshan Andrabi stated that preachers, not politicians, would determine sermon subjects. This reversal came two days… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: LA Mayor Race: Bass and Raman Clash in Final Debate
item.description: Karen Bass and Rick Caruso engaged in their final debate for the Los Angeles mayoral race, with a key point of contention being the role of the police chief. The candidates traded blows over this issue in the lead-up to the election. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Bike Lane Removal Faces Supreme Court Challenge in Toronto
item.description: The Ford government has begun removing bike lanes in Etobicoke, Toronto. In response, advocacy groups CycleTO and EcoJustice are challenging the removal plans and have announced they will appeal the case to the Supreme Court of Canada. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Activist Announces New Protest Date and Location
item.description: Activist Abhijit Dipke has announced a new date and location for a gathering. The protest will not take place at Jantar Mantar this time, but in a different area of Delhi. The Lallantop reported that Dipke informed people of the new date… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Cabinet Approves 78-Day Bonus for 11.4 Lakh Railway Employees
item.description: The Union Cabinet has approved a Productivity Linked Bonus for approximately 11.4 lakh eligible railway employees. The bonus, totaling Rs 2,009.61 crore, will be paid out as 78 days' wages. The maximum bonus amount an individual employee… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 11 · Right 5.

item.title: Alberta Referendum Questions Examined
item.description: Coverage from CBC News and CTV News focuses on the nine referendum questions posed to Albertans. Both outlets examine Question #9, indicating a focus on the specific inquiries presented during the referendum process. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Iran Faces Political Infighting Amid Economic Woes and War
item.description: Iran is experiencing deepening political infighting as economic difficulties persist during wartime. Hardliners are increasing pressure on the government, demanding the removal of Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi. The oil minister has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 3.

item.title: Burnham Rules Out Green Party Deal
item.description: Andy Burnham has ruled out a deal with the Green Party, citing a motion that described 'Zionism is racism'. The Independent reported that Burnham made this decision. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Senate Races Highlight Impact of Trump Policies
item.description: Senate races in Michigan and Kansas are becoming liabilities for Donald Trump due to his policies on tariffs and the Iran war, according to reports. The coverage suggests that Trump's unpopular policies are being tested in these… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kamala Harris Extends Midterm Campaign, Postpones 2028 Decision
item.description: Vice President Kamala Harris has added stops to her final midterm election campaign tour. She stated that her decision regarding a potential 2028 presidential run will be made at a later time. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Toronto Election Sees Record Advance Voting Turnout
item.description: Advance voting for the Toronto election has reached its highest turnout in over a decade, with more than 220,000 ballots cast. The city has reported this record figure for the 2026 election. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Japan PM says housework makes her busier than male predecessors
item.description: Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida stated that housework makes her busier than her male predecessors. She also commented on her personal routine, mentioning that she bathes but does not apply makeup. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: New Vice-Chancellor Appointed to Punjab Agricultural University
item.description: Dr. Harvinder Singh Dhaliwal has been appointed as the new Vice-Chancellor of Punjab Agricultural University in Ludhiana. Dhaliwal is credited as the developer of new varieties of kinnow, banana, and amla. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Mayawati Demands Regularisation of Contract Workers in UP
item.description: Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) chief Mayawati has demanded the regularisation of contract workers employed under the National Health Mission (NHM) in Uttar Pradesh. She stated that outsourcing is an exploitative arrangement and called for the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sweden's Centre-Left Leader Fails Again to Form Government
item.description: Magdalena Andersson, the leader of Sweden's Social Democrats, has announced that the conditions are not in place for her to form a government, marking a second unsuccessful attempt. This prolongs a political deadlock in the country. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Australian Treasurer Warns Against Underestimating One Nation Party
item.description: Australian Treasurer Jim Chalmers has warned that the Labor party cannot assume the One Nation party will fade away, highlighting its sustained polling strength. Chalmers indicated that the government is focusing on the party's perceived… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
